title: confiture migrate baseline --format json
description: What `migrate baseline` recorded as applied without running it. `mode` names the shape: `through` marks the local migration files up to --through, `from_db` copies the ledger rows of another database (--from-db). With --dry-run nothing is written and the payload says what would be. A failure writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

oneOf.description: --through: each local migration file up to and including the named version, and what it became.

dry_run.description: True with --dry-run: nothing was written to the ledger.

migrations.description: The files up to --through, in version order; empty when the migrations directory holds none.

status.description: `marked`: recorded now. `would_mark`: --dry-run, would be recorded. `already_applied`: the ledger had it; left as it was.

marked_count.description: Entries marked, or that would be with --dry-run.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.

oneOf.description: --from-db: the source database's ledger rows copied into this one's, for the versions present in the local migrations directory.

source.description: The --from-db DSN with its password replaced by `***`.

through.description: The --through cap on the copy; null when none was given.

copied.description: The source rows copied (or, with --dry-run, that would be), in version order, as the source ledger holds them.

applied_at.description: When the source applied it, in ISO 8601: `2026-09-26T13:56:41.386666+02:00`.

execution_time_ms.description: The source ledger's recorded duration, in milliseconds; null when it recorded none.

checksum.description: The source ledger's SHA-256 of the file; null when it recorded none.

skipped.description: Versions this database's ledger already had; not copied.

source_only.description: Versions the source applied that no local migration file has; not copied (a warning says so).

warnings.description: What the copy left out and why — source-only versions, versions above --through; empty if none.

dry_run.description: True with --dry-run: nothing was written to the ledger.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
